<item>
<title>
<![CDATA[ Webex for Developers Newsletter - October 2024 ]]>
...
</title>
<description>
<![CDATA[ <img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt21d3ca7f3f79e9ee/66a3c630b286e58a34216312/july-2024-webex-for-developers-newsletter---blog-1.png?width=900&height=317&fit=crop" alt="Webex for Developers Newsletter - October 2024" /> <p>Greetings, Webex Developers. In this edition, we have a bunch of new updates, announcements, and developer stories for you to enjoy. Read on to learn more!</p> <h6>🛠️Announcing the Multistream Feature in the Web Meetings SDK</h6><p>In a recent <a data-type='internal' to='/blog/announcing-the-multistream-feature-in-webex-web-meetings-sdk'>announcement blog post</a>, Software Engineer, Ravi Chandra Sekhar Sarika, details the new “Multistream” feature that allows developers to receive multiple individual video streams directly from a Webex meeting. This capability enables more advanced video layouts and customized views, making it easier to create dynamic and engaging video conferencing experiences.</p> <h6>🤝Getting Started with Guest-to-Guest Meetings - No Coding Required</h6><p>We also published another great <a data-type='internal' to='/blog/Getting-Started-with-Guest-to-Guest-Meetings'>how-to blog post</a> from Webex Product Manager, Ralf Schiffert, to quickly set up a complete guest-to-guest application from scratch, without any coding knowledge required.</p> <h6>🕸️🪝Service App Webhooks for Webex Service App Authorizations</h6><p>We recently announced a new webhook event that fires when a Webex Service App is authorized or deauthorized by an administrator in Control Hub. Get all the details in a <a data-type='internal' to='/blog/webhooks-for-service-app-authorizations'>new blog post</a> by Developer Evangelist, Phil Bellanti.</p> <h6>🖥️Webex Developer Public Webinars</h6><p>On Wednesday, November 13th at 1:00PM EST, join us for an insightful webinar where we&#39;ll unveil the innovative Webex Guest-to-Guest meeting model, tailored for those who need occasional access without an individual full license. Discover how to seamlessly host feature-rich meetings between non-licensed users and explore the ideal scenarios for leveraging this new offering. <a href='https://evangelism.webex.com/weblink/register/raa50d4f4d330a3d00fe7c51a7c6815f4' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Register here</a> for the live event.</p> <p>In case you can&#39;t make the live event, you can always watch the session recording later or check out all the past sessions on our <a data-type='internal' to='/webinars'>webinars page</a>.</p> <h6>📞💳The Journey of BroadSource SecureCall integration on Webex</h6><p>In a <a data-type='internal' to='/blog/enhancing-security-and-compliance-the-journey-of-broadsource-securecall-on-webex'>new guest blog post</a> by Jacqui Thals from our App Hub partner, BroadSource, you will discover how they leveraged the Webex platform to develop SecureCall, a cutting-edge solution for PCI-compliant payments and communications.</p> <h6>✈️Elevating the Airline Travel Customer Experience with the Webex Web SDK</h6><p>In <a data-type='internal' to='/blog/elevating-airline-travel-transforming-customer-experience-with-the-webex-web-sdk'>another amazing developer story</a>, Software Engineer, Adhwaith Menon, explains how a major airline leverages the Webex Web SDK to streamline customer experience at airports, making travel smoother and more enjoyable!</p> <h6>📒Webex API Changelog Recent Highlights</h6><p>September has several entries in the <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/changelog'>Webex API Changelog</a> and we always recommend checking this page frequently to stay up to date. There is one very important announcement that we want to call out again here:</p> <ul> <li><p><strong>September 25, 2024 - NEW:</strong> We are excited to announce the release of a new API that enables administrators to manage organizational details more efficiently. Key Features include: • Get Organization Details: Administrators can now retrieve comprehensive details about their organization, including current name, status, and other pertinent information. • Update Organization Name: This new functionality allows administrators to easily update the organization&#39;s name through a simple API call.</p> <ul> <li>For detailed information, please refer to our <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/v1/identity-organization'>API reference</a>.</li> </ul> </li> <li><p><strong>October 11, 2024 - BREAKING CHANGE:</strong> The <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/guest-issuer'>Guest Issuer</a> API function will reach its End of Life (EOL) on <em>December 31, 2025</em>. After this date, the Guest Issuer approach will no longer be supported or available. All guest issuer apps must transition to using <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/sa-guest-management'>Service Apps</a> for creating temporary identities to ensure continuity and take advantage of the enhanced features and support offered by Service Apps.</p> </li> </ul> ]]>

<item>
<title>
<![CDATA[ Boost.space Integrates with Webex for Seamless Data Synchronization and Workflow Management ]]>
...
</title>
<description>
<![CDATA[ <img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/bltf2b8ebfb8e0a4603/670ea6173809cb57a99549da/boost.space-webex-integration-1.png?width=900&height=317&fit=crop" alt="Boost.space Integrates with Webex for Seamless Data Synchronization and Workflow Management" /> <p>Hello everyone! My name is <a href='https://www.linkedin.com/in/v%C3%ADt-bilinec-160579234' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Vít Bilinec</a>, and I&#39;m a CCO &amp; Director of Partnerships at <a href='https://boost.space/' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Boost.space</a>, a company focused on data synchronization that connects over 2,000 third-party applications.</p> <h6>Streamlined Data with Master Database</h6><p>Businesses commonly use tens to hundreds of cloud tools, each storing data separately and in different formats, resulting in scattered data and inefficient utilization of its value. Most of them struggle with data inconsistency across their toolset and cannot get the full value of their data.</p> <p>Boost.space changes this by combining a <strong>no-code cloud database with an automation platform</strong>. It allows businesses to consolidate, standardize, and manage their data centrally, creating a Master Database. This means automating workflows and syncing data across all connected tools becomes seamless.</p> <p>By creating a <strong>Single Source of Truth</strong>, companies can <strong>not only streamline operations</strong> but also <strong>harness the power of AI effectively</strong>, as AI thrives on structured and contextualized data. Boost.space <strong>bridges the gap</strong> between disjointed business data and AI, <strong>empowering businesses to unlock their data&#39;s full value</strong>.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt2bcb2f09a1e0090b/boost.space-webex-integration-2.png" alt="Image described in surrounding text."></p> <h6>Motivation to Build on the Webex Platform</h6><p>The decision to build on the Webex platform was largely <strong>driven by the needs of our customers</strong>, as many of them were already using Webex and sought a seamless way to synchronize data between these applications for <strong>better management of their communications and workflows</strong>.</p> <p>With extensive experience in OAuth2 connections—having successfully implemented over 300 OAuth2 integrations across various applications—I am well aware of the unique challenges that each integration presents. In this instance, the support from the Webex team was invaluable in helping address specific technical requirements for this integration.</p> <h6>Use Cases: How Clients Profit from This Collaboration</h6><p>The following sections provides a variety of use cases illustrating how the Webex/Boost.space integration empowers our customers.</p> <h6>Automated HR Onboarding Process with Webex</h6><p>We&#39;ve simplified the employee onboarding process by automating task creation and setting up dedicated Webex team rooms for new hires, while tracking progress in real time.</p> <p>In this scenario, data from a Google Form completed by the new employee is used to automatically create a Webex room for communication, adding both the HR team and the new hire. The system then generates a task with specific onboarding steps, assigns an HR representative to the task, and creates a new contact in Boost.space to store the employee&#39;s information.</p> <p>This automated onboarding process improves efficiency by reducing manual tasks, ensures smooth communication with dedicated Webex rooms, and keeps the onboarding steps organized and trackable. Additionally, it centralizes employee data in Boost.space for easy management and secure access.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt08d105af95442cea/boost.space-webex-integration-3.png" alt="Image described in surrounding text."></p> <h6>Automated Incident Management with Dynamic Paths</h6><p>This scenario enables you to automatically manage incidents reported through Webex with conditional escalation based on teams while keeping all stakeholders informed.</p> <p>When a new message is posted in a designated Incident channel, ChatGPT organizes the message and assigns it to the appropriate team (Frontend, Backend, Product, or Support). The message is then turned into a task for that team and forwarded to the relevant Webex channel for resolution.</p> <p>Streamlining incident management by automating task assignments, directing issues to the correct teams, and maintaining clear communication with all stakeholders, this process helps you improve response times and efficiency.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt75382a88c7f47307/boost.space-webex-integration-4.png" alt="Image described in surrounding text."></p> <h6>APIs and SDKs Utilized</h6><p>For this integration, we employed an <strong>OAuth2 connection</strong> to seamlessly integrate Webex into Boost.space. This integration includes a <strong>variety of Webex modules, which are now available to our users.</strong> A complete list of these modules can be found on our <a href='https://boost.space/integrations/webex-meetings/' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Webex integration page</a>.</p> <p>The Webex API facilitated smooth data synchronization between the two platforms, and <strong>the OAuth2 feature proved particularly advantageous in providing secure, scalable connections.</strong></p> <p>This integration equips Boost.space with a <strong>broad range of capabilities</strong>, including the creation, updating, and deletion of rooms, teams, and memberships; managing and posting messages; and real-time monitoring of changes across rooms, messages, attachments, and memberships. <strong>Users can automate routine tasks, streamline team management, and ensure seamless collaboration—all within a secure and centralized communication platform.</strong> This powerful combination enables teams to work more efficiently, stay organized, and communicate effortlessly.</p> <h6>Review Process</h6><p>The review and approval process on the Webex App Hub was straightforward, though I would recommend developers to prepare thoroughly.</p> <p>I had the opportunity to speak directly with a Webex representative, which was extremely helpful. We discussed the more complex aspects of the integration, and I found that talking through these issues on a call was much faster than resolving them via email. This also provided the opportunity to ensure that both sides understood the nuances, making the process smoother.</p> <h6>Best Practices and Recommendations</h6><p>With Boost.space being a <strong>Key Technological Partner of Make.com</strong> and my experience in integrating similar applications, I approached the process with a clear understanding of which scopes to select and how to configure the application effectively.</p> <p>However, <strong>I highly recommend staying in close contact with the Webex team during the development and review process</strong>--they provide invaluable support. If you&#39;re working on a more complex app, setting up a call with their team can save lots of time. Also, make sure you are strict with the details of the app&#39;s configuration and test everything thoroughly before submitting it for review.</p> <h6>Conclusion</h6><p>Overall, my experience with building and integrating on the Webex platform has been very positive. The developer portal is intuitive and user-friendly, and the support provided by the Webex team has been excellent throughout the process. Furthermore, I have noticed continuous improvements in the platform&#39;s UX/UI, enhancing the developer experience with each update.</p> <p>I&#39;m excited to see how the platform evolves and look forward to future developments that will make it even more powerful for both developers and users.</p> ]]>
...
</description>

<item>
<title>
<![CDATA[ Webhooks for Service App Authorizations ]]>
...
</title>
<description>
<![CDATA[ <img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blteef29d44be058ef2/66f6d38ca0f030bad261235e/service-app-auth-webhook---blog-1.png?width=900&height=317&fit=crop" alt="Webhooks for Service App Authorizations" /> <p>A <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/service-apps'>Webex Service App</a> is special integration type that provides admin access to the Webex REST APIs on behalf of an organization. This lessens the reliance on an individual user&#39;s authorization and reduces risk to mission critical applications, like active reporting and compliance use cases. Webex administrators <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/service-apps#service-app-creation-admin-flow'>have full control</a> over what Service Apps are allowed in their organization.</p> <p>When a Service App is <em>authorized</em> by a Webex admin, the API access tokens become available to the respective developer. That Service App can also be revoked at any time when it’s <em>deauthorized</em> by the admin. Developers can now be notified of these events with the introduction of a new <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/guides/webhooks'>webhook</a> resource <code>serviceApp</code> and events <code>authorized</code> or <code>deauthorized</code>. This provides an automatic method to communicate Service App status changes and enable different workflows from those events. For example, if a Service App is running a critical process (such as active call reporting) and is unexpectedly deauthorized, this can trigger a workflow to send an alert to the team that depends on the reports. Let’s take a closer look at how these webhook events work.</p> <h6>Register the Webhook</h6><p>To be notified when a Service App is authorized or deauthorized, developers can subscribe to the new webhook resource - <code>serviceApp</code> and specify the event as <code>authorized</code> or <code>deauthorized</code>.</p> <p>By default, these webhooks will notify on <em>all</em> Service App authorized or deauthorized events for that developer. To limit those event notifications to specific Service Apps or Webex sites, there are four filters available:</p> <ul> <li><code>id</code><ul> <li>Notify by Service App ID</li> </ul> </li> <li><code>friendlyName</code><ul> <li>Notify by the Service App “friendly”name.</li> </ul> </li> <li><code>trainSiteNames</code><ul> <li>Notify by Webex site names</li> </ul> </li> <li><code>adminTrainSiteName</code><ul> <li>Notify by the admin Webex site name</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>For example, creating a webhook to notify when a specific Service App is authorized is as simple as sending a POST to the <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/v1/webhooks/create-a-webhook'>/v1/webhooks API</a> with the following JSON body:</p> <pre><code class="language-json">{ &quot;name&quot;: &quot;Service Apps authorization&quot;, &quot;targetUrl&quot;: &quot;https://example.com/mywebhook&quot;, &quot;resource&quot;: &quot;serviceApp&quot;, &quot;event&quot;: &quot;authorized&quot;, &quot;filter&quot;: &quot;id=ZGYtODM3YTRmZjkxOTEw&quot; } </code></pre> <p>Notice the filter that is applied there, which tells Webex to notify only when a Service App with that <code>id</code> is <code>authorized</code> by an organization.</a> For more information on creating webhooks, check out the <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/guides/webhooks'>developer guide</a>.</p> <h6>Webhook Payloads</h6><p>When the above webhook is triggered by a new admin authorization for the Service App, the JSON payload received will look something like this:</p> <pre><code class="language-json">{ &quot;id&quot;: &quot;ZGYtODM3YTRmZjkxOTEw&quot;, &quot;name&quot;: &quot;My Service App Auth&quot;, &quot;targetUrl&quot;: &quot;https://example.com/appUrl&quot;, &quot;resource&quot;: &quot;serviceApp&quot;, &quot;event&quot;: &quot;authorized&quot;, &quot;orgId&quot;: &quot;MDVhNzA1ZDcwYjQ&quot;, &quot;createdBy&quot;: &quot;Zi05YjA0MDZkZjFkOTY&quot;, &quot;appId&quot;: &quot;Njk2YWMwYTEwN2Q2YTg5MjI3&quot;, &quot;ownedBy&quot;: &quot;creator&quot;, &quot;status&quot;: &quot;active&quot;, &quot;created&quot;: &quot;2024-06-05T18:09:34.929Z&quot;, &quot;actorId&quot;: &quot;Yjk2YS03NGQ4NWYxNjU1ZmE&quot;, &quot;data&quot;: { &quot;id&quot;: &quot;ZDllNzczMzllOGVlODI5OTll&quot;, &quot;friendlyId&quot;: &quot;super-special-service-app&quot;, &quot;authorizerId&quot;: &quot;Yjk2YS03NGQ4NWYxNjU1ZmE&quot;, &quot;authorizerOrgId&quot;: &quot;YTU2YS1iMDVhNzA1ZDcwYjQ&quot;, &quot;authorizationDate&quot;: &quot;2024-06-12T14:19:52.168Z&quot;, &quot;scopes&quot;: [ &quot;spark:kms&quot;, &quot;meeting:admin_schedule_write&quot; ], &quot;trainSiteNames&quot;: [ &quot;clgmaiyaaq.webex.com&quot; ], &quot;adminTrainSiteNames&quot;: [ &quot;clgmaiyaaq.webex.com&quot; ] } } </code></pre> <p>As you can see, the values that correspond to the four available webhook filters are included in the JSON payload. The payload for a <code>deauthorized</code> event will have the same data fields, making it easier to handle both events. Receiving these real-time events allows your application to perform the next steps in your development workflow!</p> <h6>Need Some Help? We Got You Covered!</h6><p>We are delighted to provide assistance if you need any help with these new webhooks. As always, the <a data-type='internal' to='/support'>Webex Developer Support Team</a> is standing by and happy to assist. You can also start or join a conversation on the <a href='https://cs.co/WebexDeveloperCommunity' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Webex for Developers Community Forum</a>. Until next time, happy developing!</p> ]]>
...
</description>

<item>
<title>
<![CDATA[ Getting Started with Guest-to-Guest Meetings - No Coding Required ]]>
...
</title>
<description>
<![CDATA[ <img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt388f064eae5e545c/66ecbd38883680b8bac3d56f/guestchairs.jpg?width=900&height=317&fit=crop" alt="Getting Started with Guest-to-Guest Meetings - No Coding Required" /> <p>Are you intrigued by the brilliance of the Webex Suite? The legendary audio and video quality, the phenomenal virtual backgrounds that let you host meetings from the captain&#39;s chair of a SpaceX rocket, and the sleek, elegant experience of Cisco room devices! But then, you dive into the licensing details and find them a bit too rigid for your taste. You crave something more flexible, something that doesn&#39;t tie licenses to specific users. You&#39;re not looking for a minutes-based system either; predictability is key, and you don&#39;t want to wade through cumbersome monthly reports. Most of your users only occasionally need to conduct meetings, so what&#39;s the solution?</p> <p>Enter guest-to-guest meetings!</p> <p>Imagine full-featured Webex meetings between non-licensed users. No more binding licenses to individual names! The host is a Webex Service App orchestrating the meeting, giving you the flexibility you need. And the best part? There&#39;s a new guest-to-guest SKU, allowing you to pay only for the number of simultaneous sessions. With everything running through the central Service App, your code logic becomes simpler, making development and maintenance a breeze.</p> <p>Intrigued? If your curiosity is piqued, read on for a quick walkthrough of this game-changing guest-to-guest functionality. We&#39;ll start from scratch and guide you through setting up a meeting between two guests in just a few simple steps.</p> <p>A Quick Note on Hyperlinks</p> <p>Most hyperlinks in this text are deep links. For instance, when I mention finding your guest site in Control Hub, I link directly to the page where the sites are listed. If deep linking isn&#39;t possible, I&#39;ll provide clear instructions on how to get there. In other words, make sure to take advantage of the many hyperlinks I&#39;ve included!</p> <h6>What you need</h6><p>Before we dive into the magic of guest-to-guest meetings, here&#39;s what you&#39;ll need to get started:</p> <p>1. A Webex Account: You&#39;ll need an account to log in to the Developer Portal and request a <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/service-apps-as-g2g-meeting-facilitator-guide'>guest-to-guest (g2g) sandbox</a>. Don&#39;t have an account? No worries! You can <a href='https://www.webex.com/' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>sign up for a free</a> one in no time. <img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt9c0dffa00ff577ae/66ec850a164dbf42c75aff87/Picture1.png" alt="Webex Signup Page"></p> <p>2. The <a href='https://www.postman.com/' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Postman</a> API Tool: This handy tool will be your best friend for API calls. I&#39;ll be sharing a <a href='https://www.usebruno.com/' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Bruno</a> collection in my GitHub soon, so check back occasionally!</p> <p>3. GitHub Postman Repository: Make sure to access and download the WebexSamples GitHub <a href='https://github.com/WebexSamples/g2g-meeting-sample' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>repository</a> specifically set up for g2g meetings.</p> <p>4. A Browser: Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Opera-take your pick! Personally, I like to keep things organized by using different browsers for my sandbox <em>developer</em> and sandbox <em>admin</em> roles (Safari and Firefox), but feel free to follow your own style. Wondering where the admin fits in? Hold tight; the wonders of our sandbox and Service Apps are about to unfold!</p> <p>5. Node.js: If you&#39;d like to use a simple script I created to launch Chrome tabs from Postman, you&#39;ll need <a href='https://nodejs.org/en/download/package-manager' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Node.js</a>. This script makes it a breeze for guests to join the meeting via the Webex web interface-one tab per guest.</p> <p>Here is what we are working towards. This is a meeting between a Dr. and a patient in Webex (both me from the same camera feed) -- neither is licensed for meetings. This happens in a browser for simplicity, but it translates to the SDKs and Widgets, which we will show you later.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt17f32be910184fef/66ec850aff82bd7f682d18ad/Picture2.png" alt="Dr. and Patient meet - neither is licensed for Webex -- The Small insert is The Self View"></p> <p>If you&#39;re thinking, &quot;I&#39;ve seen this experience a million times,&quot; you&#39;re absolutely right-and that&#39;s the beauty of it! We&#39;re not here to reinvent the meeting experience itself. Instead, we&#39;re transforming the way you get there. With minimal coding required, we&#39;re offering a scalable solution that&#39;s fully compliant with the Webex Suite Meetings Platform. It&#39;s all about making your life easier while delivering the seamless, high-quality Webex experience you know and love.</p> <h6>Request A Sandbox</h6><p>Ready? Let&#39;s go. We&#39;ll start working with our sandbox. After you requested your sandbox, you should have received a welcome email with instructions on how to access it. The sender is <a href='mailto:cortex@wbx.ninja' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>cortex@wbx.ninja</a> if you want to check your spam folder. Use your admin credentials to log in to <a href='https://admin.webex.com/' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Control Hub</a>.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt2b86fa9796cd7849/66ec850a3429370b67a17495/Picture3.png" alt="Sample welcome email for your new sandbox"></p> <p>Let&#39;s dive in and check out your sandbox to see that a g2g site is all setup and ready for us to use. You can check this in <a href='https://admin.webex.com/meetings/site-list' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>the site list</a>. Here is how mine looks like. Notice the <em>Guest-to-Guest site</em> label under Additional Information? That&#39;s just what we expect. If you don&#39;t see it you may have requested a regular sandbox, right now g2g sandboxes are different from suite sandboxes, but we&#39;ll merge them soon.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/bltc1686bdfd78c4f0e/66ec850ae6c606242fa802db/Picture4.png" alt="Guest to Guest site Preconfigured in the Sandbox"> </p> <h6>Create a Developer User</h6><p>Next, we&#39;ll <a href='https://admin.webex.com/manage-users/users' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>create a developer user</a>. The developer will then craft the <a data-type='internal' to='/my-apps'>guest-to-guest Service App</a> in the <a data-type='internal' to='/'>Developer Portal</a>, and the admin will give it the green light using the <a href='https://admin.webex.com/apps/service-apps' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Control Hub GUI</a>. The best part? In your sandbox, you get to play both roles!<br><br>I&#39;ve deep linked all the relevant sections above, making the process self-evident with our intuitive Control Hub GUI. Once you&#39;ve created the developer user, they&#39;ll receive a welcome email with instructions to activate their account-essentially, just log in and set a password.</p> <h6>Create the Guest-to-Guest Service App</h6><p>Now we&#39;re getting to the exciting parts! In the Developer Portal, <a data-type='internal' to='/my-apps/new/service-app'>create a new app of type &quot;Service App.&quot;</a> Fill in the fields and select one of the default app logos. The name of the Service App may show in the meeting roster of some of the clients. Use a name you don&#39;t feel embarrassed about later. More importantly, let&#39;s focus on the scope list. At a minimum, I recommend including the following scopes:</p> <p>• <em>meeting:schedules_read</em></p> <p>• <em>meeting:schedules_write</em></p> <p>• <em>meeting:preferences_read</em></p> <p>• <em>meeting:preferences_write</em></p> <p>• And the most crucial one: <em>guest-meeting:rw</em></p> <p>The <em>guest-meeting:rw</em> scope identifies this Service App as a guest-to-guest Service App, granting it special privileges and a tailored flow in the Control Hub approval process, where a guest-to-guest site must be selected.</p> <p>If you want to use the SDK demo, you need to ensure the Service App can create guests. You can do this by selecting these additional scopes:</p> <p>• <em>guest-issuer:read</em></p> <p>• <em>guest-issuer:write</em></p> <p>After creating your Service App, you&#39;ll be presented with the <em>clientId</em> and <em>clientSecret</em>. You can store the secret now or recreate it later-either way works. However, you must submit your new Service App for admin approval. Simply click the &quot;Request Admin Authorization&quot; button to do this.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/bltd0de38fb4e615ce6/66ec850a164dbfccaf5aff83/Picture5.png" alt="Request admin authorization makes the service app visible to the admin in Control Hub"></p> <h6>Authorize the Service App</h6><p>Now it&#39;s time to use your sandbox admin account to approve the g2g Service App. Log in to the <a href='https://admin.webex.com/apps/service-apps' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Service Apps approval site</a>, select the newly created Service App, and authorize it. During the authorization process, it will automatically select the guest-to-guest site for you. There&#39;s a one-to-one mapping between a g2g Service App and a guest site.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/bltf02af2607f84f747/66ec850afa6ba410ae0c9c6b/Picture6.png" alt="Authorize guest-to-Guest Service App"></p> <p>If you later create another Service App with the guest-meeting:rw scope and want to authorize it, you&#39;ll first need to release the current guest-to-guest site. If you want several guest-to-guest sites for your customers in one org, you can purchase multiple subscriptions and run them in parallel, each with their own assigned Service App.</p> <h6>Retrieving the Token</h6><p>Okay, we&#39;re almost there-just one last step before the real fun begins! The developer needs to retrieve the token for the Service App, which will be used to orchestrate and manage the g2g meetings. Head over to the Developer Portal and navigate to your Service App page. Look for the &quot;Org Authorizations&quot; segment. If you don&#39;t see it, simply refresh the page.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt1073fc03aac599d5/66ec850ade00f91bf50e3dcc/Picture7.png" alt="Retrieve Access Token for g2g Service App"></p> <p>Select your sandbox organization from the dropdown list (there should be only one), and then copy the <em>clientSecret</em> into the field to generate the <em>access</em> and <em>refresh tokens</em>. Finally, copy the access token for use in your Postman collection.</p> <h6>Wrapping Up the Prep Work</h6><p>There is one more thing we want to do. We want to enable meetings between only guests. This is so no one has explicit host control over the meeting. If you want a guest to be the host, you can use the <em>startLink</em> instead of the <em>joinLink</em> later in the Postman flow.<br><br>To allow meetings between only attendees select your <a href='https://admin.webex.com/meetings/site-list' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>guest site in Control Hub</a>. Click it. Select &quot;All&quot; and &quot;Security&quot;.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt35b7eaa2efa81fde/66ec850a9ae20520b96859b4/Picture8.png" alt="Site Configuration in Control Hub. Sites -- All - Select Security."></p> <p>Make sure you select the &quot;They can join the meeting&quot; under the Webex Meeting Security Section.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt268c071838242693/66ec850a88368053ddc3d30b/Picture9.png" alt="Allow guests to join"></p> <p>Select the right settings for &quot;Join before host.&quot;</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/bltfddb91f510cd0221/66ec850a8d84784a08304c56/Picture10.png" alt="Allow Guests to join without the Host"></p> <p>So far, everything we&#39;ve done is just the prep work. If you&#39;ve used Service Apps before, this process is probably second nature to you, and you&#39;ve likely gone through it many times. That&#39;s another advantage of our g2g offering-it builds solidly on top of existing concepts and frameworks. There&#39;s very little that&#39;s new here, yet we&#39;re able to create a powerful, new and innovative solution.</p> <h6>Use the SA Token to orchestrate g2g meetings</h6><h6>Start the helper script</h6><p>Now, let&#39;s move on to the exciting part! With our Service App token in hand, we&#39;ll quickly schedule a meeting. We&#39;ll create a join link for each guest, allowing them to join the meeting with a simple click through their browser.\</p> <p>If you want to make use of the script, I wrote that opens the browser tab with the <em>joinLink</em> you need to start it with<br><br>node runChromeTab.js<br><br>The script, like the Postman collection, is part of the <a href='https://github.com/WebexSamples/g2g-meeting-sample' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>repository</a> I linked to earlier.</p> <h6>Import Postman Collection and configure Access Token</h6><p>First, let&#39;s set a new and empty environment for the Postman collection. Go to the &quot;Environment Quick Look&quot; icon on the right side and add a new one.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/bltb76f10699c9c02c7/66ec8834f4d6ab471b6d379a/Picture11.png" alt="Postman environment Variables Quick look"></p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt363ede9ec087c61c/66ec8835a924ba67e7df57d5/Picture12.png" alt="Postman create a new environment for Advanced functions in the collection"></p> <p>Next import the g2g Collection into Postman</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt4e9f211e36730cde/66ec8835c8a41630aba9893f/Picture13.png" alt="Import the g2g collection into Postman"></p> <p>When the Collection is loaded copy your access token into the Collection&#39;s authorization. Ensure Auth Type: Bearer Token is selected. All API requests will be done with this g2g Service App token. Press Save for Postman to use this token.<br><br><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt8ddd082dbfb925c0/66ec8835790a3d125cdd78e1/Picture14.png" alt="Set the Service App Access Token for the Collection"> <br>Verify that your token is configured correctly by executing the <strong>GET Service App meeting preferences API call</strong> -- You should see a response similar to the following.<br><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt34acb4ceeccc2e49/66ec8835fa6ba401b90c9c7f/Picture15.png" alt="Assert Validity of access token by calling meeting preferences on the Service App"></p> <h6>Schedule Guest to Guest Meeting and join Guests</h6><p>If this worked, you are almost there. We only need to do two more things</p> <ul> <li><p>Have the Service App schedule a meeting via the meetings REST API</p> </li> <li><p>Join guests to the meeting with the meeting joinLinks</p> </li> </ul> <p>Scheduling the meeting is done via the Postman <strong>POST Service App creates guest-to-guest meeting .</strong></p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt225a6816e11338b2/66ec883436f3bd00e4407885/Picture16.png" alt="The Service App Schedules the meeting"></p> <p>Just send the request via Postman. There is some Javascript magic going on. Meetings are always scheduled in 15min intervals past the hour (xx:00,xx:15,xx:30,xx:45) and run for half an hour. Scheduling them so close to the current wall time means we can join them right away.</p> <p>Use the Service App to create the <em>joinLink</em> by executing the</p> <p><strong>create guest 1 join link and join as attendee</strong> in Postman.</p> <p>If you have the JS script running it will create a <em>joinLink</em> pass it to the script and the script launches a Chrome tab with the link. If you get an error you may not run the JS script I mentioned, and you need to copy the <em>joinLink</em> manually from the Postman response and copy it into a browser tab.<br><br>When you see this dialog press &quot;Cancel&quot; and then &quot;Continue in this Browser&quot;.<img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt766d41e92ffc7d38/66ec88342c6c3cf42671e784/Picture17.png" alt="Click Cancel - We will meet in a browser tab"></p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt207ca2c6f298a2c1/66ec8834acf78ecf04c0e7ba/Picture18.png" alt="Continue in this browser will open a Tab with the meeting experience"></p> <p>You may need to approve microphone and camera access. Then you should be in the meeting.<br>Here is how it looks after the first guest joins and with video turned off so you can see the guests name.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt4311c31b0c885bdb/66ec88341d1e95fe6b22901d/Picture19.png" alt="First guest joined - you need to approve audio and video access in the browser when prompted"></p> <p>Call the Postman API <strong>create guest 2 join link and join as attendee</strong> to join the other guest ( here the Dr. ) in the same way.</p> <p>Huzzah! You have your first g2g meeting running live. None of the participants are licensed. In fact, you can schedule and start as many meetings as your Service App is licensed for, each with two or more guests.</p> <h6>Wrapping up and Trying out the SDK</h6><p>We&#39;re essentially done, but I promised one more thing if you want to try out the SDK. We&#39;ll use the <a href='https://webex.github.io/webex-js-sdk/samples/browser-plugin-meetings/' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>KitchenSink JS App</a>, a modular frontend to the JS SDK. To launch the SDK, you&#39;ll need an identity (a person ID), which we don&#39;t have yet. If you selected the <em>guest-issuer:read/write</em> scope earlier for your Service App, you can proceed right here. If not, you&#39;ll need to update the scope list, add the necessary scopes, then deauthorize/authorize and retrieve a new access token to use in the Postman collection.</p> <p>Once you are ready call this API in Postman</p> <p><strong>Service App creates guest 1</strong>.</p> <p>You will see an output like this<br><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt4daca2e19b170a77/66ec88348d84787a17304c8e/Picture20.png" alt="Create a guest identity to launch the SDK"></p> <p>Copy the guest <em>accessToken</em>, then head over to the Kitchen Sink App and insert it before calling Webex.init()</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/bltc74f6405a1cad291/66ec884b0ebcddaf68f09a0b/Picture21.png" alt="The guest Access Token is used to init the SDK"></p> <p>A button will turn green to allow you to register your SDK/device to the Webex cloud. Do it.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/bltf38700cee4cff585/66ec884b76bb2e7dba9c8fbe/Picture22.png" alt="The SDK registers liker a device"></p> <p>We are now registered as the guest with Webex. All we need to do is find and join our meeting. There&#39;s a section called &quot;Manage Meeting&quot; in the Kitchen Sink App. I found it easiest to use the meeting&#39;s <em>sipAddress</em>. In your Postman collection, locate the API response body where you scheduled the meeting, copy the <em>sipAddress</em>, and insert it into the Kitchen Sink app.<br><br><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt46e07acd0b734bbf/66ec884bc8a416109ba98943/Picture23.png" alt="Retrieve the meeting\&#39;s SIP address"></p> <p>Press Create Meeting and then radio-button-select it.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt64fe8fea836a5677/66ec884be2f8762c22404261/Picture24.png" alt="Find the meeting. Create Meeting will find it. Then select the radio button"></p> <p>In the &quot;Join Meeting&quot; section, copy your password from the Postman response and verify it. Once that&#39;s done, you can join the meeting from the SDK as a guest by clicking &quot;Join With Media.&quot;</p> <p>That&#39;s it-you should now have three guests in the same meeting!!<img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt8e726b425ae0fb69/66ec884b8d84780355304c93/Picture25.png" alt="Join the meeting with Media"></p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt5e30de85c4a96af1/66ec884b1ad0c133ac4b25cb/Picture26.png" alt="SDK Kitchen sink is connected to the meeting"></p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt40a492d3b9ae0dfc/66ec884b497b074b429fce53/Picture27.png" alt="3 guests in the meeting"></p> <p>The only thing that has changed here is how we join the meeting. The guest-to-guest Service App is still the orchestrator and license sponsor.</p> <h6>Conclusion</h6><p>Thanks for sticking around until now. As promised, we started with nothing and ended with guest-to-guest meetings where non-licensed temporary users can freely meet. We spent most of our time on setup, but to get a g2g meeting running, we used only one API call for the Service App to schedule a meeting. You can repeat this for as many meetings as you like. Meetings in progress are counted against the Service App&#39;s maximum limit.</p> <p>We believe this new offer and new ordering SKU will unlock new use cases and enable customers who previously relied on space-backed meetings to easily port their applications.</p> <p>If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to support at <a href='mailto:devsupport@webex.com' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>devsupport@webex.com</a> or to me via <a href='mailto:Webex-devex@cisco.com' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Webex-devex@cisco.com</a>.</p> ]]>

<title>
<![CDATA[ Enhancing Customer Engagement with Outbound Voice Campaigns in Webex Contact Center ]]>
...
</title>
<description>
<![CDATA[ <img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt4568ebbc92c2a2e8/66f432a7ee6d373ce5a75b8a/outbound-voice-campaigns-1.jpeg?width=900&height=317&fit=crop" alt="Enhancing Customer Engagement with Outbound Voice Campaigns in Webex Contact Center" /> <p>Customer engagement is crucial for businesses, and they are always looking for innovative ways to connect with their audience, provide personalized experiences, and drive meaningful experiences. For decades, Cisco has provided solutions that power the customer service functions for businesses. One of the latest innovations in Webex Contact Center is to build an in-house dialer service which supports progressive and predictive campaigns with any third-party campaign manager.</p> <h6>Why Outbound Voice Campaigns?</h6><p>With outbound voice campaigns, businesses can reach out to their customers proactively and efficiently. This capability will help customers to increase their revenue through running specific sales &amp; marketing campaigns. Outbound campaigns can be utilized across various industry verticals like launch of new products launch, announcing sales, appointment reminders, and collecting feedback on services, and product updates. These use cases encompass verticals like retail, financial, healthcare, telecom, etc.</p> <h6>Key Features</h6><p>Outbound voice campaigns offer the following services:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Automated Dialing</strong>: Upload contacts directly to the campaign manager, and the dialer service will call the contacts on behalf of the agents at an adjustable pace based on the campaign requirement.</li> <li><strong>Blended Agent:</strong> Agents can be part of Inbound and outbound queues providing flexibility to business to prioritize Inbound over outbound calls or vice versa resulting in optimized resource utilization.</li> <li><strong>Answering Machine Detection:</strong> Detects voicemail systems and leaves pre-recorded messages, ensuring that the message is delivered even if the call is not answered.</li> <li><strong>Adhering Compliance:</strong> Ensures adherence to regulatory standards such as maintaining proper abandonment rates, support for DNC/NDNC, State timings, holiday support, block/unblock area and zip code.</li> <li><strong>Campaign &amp; Dialing Insights:</strong> Delivers detailed reports to gain insights into customer interactions and campaign effectiveness.</li> <li><strong>Contact Strategy:</strong> Effectively engage with customers through multiple channels or numbers, providing flexibility in determining the allowed retries, adjusting the callable time for each number and channel, and defining the rescheduling strategy for each outcome of an attempt.</li> </ul> <br/> <h6>Get Started!</h6><p>Outbound voice campaigns are available in Cisco Webex Contact Center. Purchase the campaign management SKU and start using the campaign management capabilities immediately! Refer to the following links for end-to-end configuration information as well as a Campaign Manager guide:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Configuration Technote</strong>: <a href='https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nqu2kub/Configure-Voice-Outbound-Campaign-Modes-in-Webex-Contact-Center' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/nqu2kub/Configure-Voice-Outbound-Campaign-Modes-in-Webex-Contact-Center</a></li> <li><strong>Campaign Manager Guide</strong>: <a href='https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/ngtxjux/Webex-Contact-Center-Campaign-Manager-User-Guide' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/ngtxjux/Webex-Contact-Center-Campaign-Manager-User-Guide</a></li> </ul> <br/> <h6>Need Some Help? We Got You Covered!</h6><p>We are excited to provide you with support for these features. If you need help, the <a data-type='internal' to='/support'>Webex Developer Support Team</a> is standing by and happy to assist. You can also start or join a conversation on the <a href='https://cs.co/WebexDeveloperCommunity' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Webex for Developers Community Forum</a>.</p> ]]>
...

<item>
<title>
<![CDATA[ Enhancing Security and Compliance: The Journey of BroadSource SecureCall on Webex ]]>
...
</title>
<description>
<![CDATA[ <img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt01710a3dac9b0711/66e856719b0072272d2bbd52/broadsource-securecall-for-webex---guest-blog-1.png?width=900&height=317&fit=crop" alt="Enhancing Security and Compliance: The Journey of BroadSource SecureCall on Webex" /> <p>BroadSource is a leader in developing highly specialized software solutions for Cloud Communications and Cloud Contact Centers. This blog shares our SecureCall development journey, an innovative application designed to enhance security and compliance for Webex users.</p> <p>SecureCall by BroadSource is designed to offer an additional layer of security by ensuring PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard) compliance is achievable for all Webex customers, who take payments by phone. With the increasing reliance on cloud communication platforms, we recognized the need for a solution that provides enterprises and businesses, of any size, in any industry, with the peace of mind that their communications are secure and compliant with industry standards.</p> <p>Businesses and enterprises benefit by:</p> <ul> <li>De-scoping their payments-by-phone transactions, demonstrating to their bank or qualified security assessor (QSA) that they are PCI-DSS compliant</li> <li>Reducing annual cyber security insurance premiums</li> <li>Reducing the costs of annual security audits</li> <li>Reducing costly Mail Order / Telephone Order (MOTO) processing transaction fees</li> <li>Avoiding customer card details being shared or stored when receiving payments pay by phone</li> </ul> <p>SecureCall is a Level 1 PCI compliant cloud, available globally, that integrates with Webex Calling, Webex Calling Wholesale, Webex Essentials, Webex Contact Center and BroadWorks service providers.</p> <h6>Our Experience Building on the Webex Platform</h6><p>The decision to build SecureCall on the Webex platform was driven by our commitment to delivering top-tier security solutions that integrate seamlessly with leading communication tools. Webex, with its robust set of features and a growing user base, was the perfect platform for us to achieve this.</p> <p>Building on the Webex platform was a step forward in the use of Cisco’s Call Control APIs. BroadSource has decades of experience in developing applications against the Cisco BroadWorks platform and now the Webex APIs afforded the development team an improved environment to maximize SecureCall’s interactions with Webex.</p> <h6>APIs and SDKs Utilized in Building SecureCall</h6><p>In developing SecureCall, we leveraged several Webex APIs and SDKs that were instrumental in helping us achieve our goals. The Webex Calling API was particularly valuable, as it allowed us to access and manage call data securely, ensuring that SecureCall could be applied seamlessly to calls between businesses and their customers.</p> <h6>The Review Process: Getting SecureCall on the Webex App Hub</h6><p>Getting SecureCall reviewed and published on the Webex App Hub was thorough, ensuring that every aspect of SecureCall met Webex’s high standards for security and functionality.</p> <p>While we anticipated a rigorous review, the depth of information we needed to provide about SecureCall’s security protocols was more extensive than expected. However, this only underscored Webex’s commitment to ensuring that only the best and most secure apps are available to its users.</p> <p>For other developers looking to publish their apps on the Webex App Hub, our advice would be to invest time in thorough documentation. The more detailed and clear your documentation is, the smoother the review process will be.</p> <h6>Best Practices for Building on the Webex Platform</h6><p>Based on our experience, here are some best practices for other developers looking to build successful apps on the Webex platform:</p> <h6>Deep Integration with Webex APIs</h6><p>Take full advantage of the Webex APIs and SDKs available. They are powerful tools that can help you create apps that are both robust and user-friendly.</p> <h6>Security First</h6><p>Ensure that your app’s security features are top-notch, especially if you’re dealing with sensitive data. The Webex platform is trusted by millions, and security should always be a priority.</p> <h6>Collaborate with the Webex Team</h6><p>Don’t hesitate to reach out to the <a data-type='internal' to='/support'>Webex Developer Support team</a>. Their insights can be invaluable in helping you navigate challenges and optimize your app’s performance.</p> <h6>Thorough Testing</h6><p>Conduct extensive testing across various scenarios to ensure your app works seamlessly within the Webex environment. This will help you catch any potential issues before your app goes live.</p> <h6>Visualizing SecureCall</h6><p>As a part of the new <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/embedded-apps-framework-sidebar-api-quick-start'>Webex Calling sidebar functionality</a>, SecureCall sits seamlessly withing the Webex experience. To give you a better idea of how SecureCall works, here are some screenshots of our app in action:</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/bltc8ac28a537b9fc63/image0001.png" alt="Image described in surrounding text."></p> <p>When a Webex user needs to process a payment, they simply click ‘Press to Secure,’ seamlessly adding SecureCall to the ongoing call using the Webex Call Control APIs.</p> <p>Once SecureCall is integrated into the call, the Webex sidebar transforms into a credit card payment terminal. The Webex user and customer can continue their conversation, but instead of verbally sharing their credit card information, the customer securely enters the details using their phone&#39;s dial pad. The Webex user remains on the line to guide the customer through the process without being exposed to any sensitive information, ensuring a PCI-compliant Webex call.</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/bltc1492d8606a71035/broadsource-securecall-for-webex---guest-blog-3.png" alt="Image described in surrounding text."></p> <p>These images showcase the seamless integration of SecureCall within the Webex Calling environment, providing users with enhanced security without disrupting their workflow.</p> <h6>Endless Opportunities for Innovation</h6><p>The Webex platform is a powerful tool for developers. Our journey building SecureCall on the Webex platform has been both challenging and rewarding. We’re proud of the solution we’ve created, and we’re excited about the future possibilities of further enhancing security for Webex users.</p> <p>We look forward to continuing our work with Webex and contributing to the future of secure, cloud-based communications.</p> <p>To use SecureCall by BroadSource, visit <a href='https://apphub.webex.com/applications/securecall-for-webex-calling-sidebar-broadsource-group-pty-ltd' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>SecureCall on the Webex App Hub</a>.</p> <p>Feel free to <a href='https://www.broadsource.com.au/contact/' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>connect with us</a> and share your experience.</p> ]]>
...
</description>

<item>
<title>
<![CDATA[ Announcing the Multistream Feature in Webex Web Meetings SDK ]]>
...
</title>
<description>
<![CDATA[ <img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt014354b5b11257f0/66eb2bb85fcc6a95c0cd57a9/multi-stream-blog-1.jpeg?width=900&height=317&fit=crop" alt="Announcing the Multistream Feature in Webex Web Meetings SDK" /> <p>The <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/sdks/webex-meetings-sdk-web-introduction'>Webex Web Meetings SDK</a> is a powerful tool designed to enable developers to seamlessly integrate Webex meeting capabilities into their web applications. With this SDK, developers can create, join, and manage Webex meetings directly from their web-based platforms, delivering a rich and interactive video conferencing experience. The SDK provides a comprehensive set of APIs and functionalities, including high-quality video and audio, screen sharing, meeting controls, and participant management.</p> <h6>What is Multistream?</h6><p>In a traditional transcoded meeting, all video streams from participants are processed and combined into a single composite video stream before being sent to each participant. This approach simplifies video processing but has limitations in flexibility and quality.</p> <p>The Multistream feature allows developers to receive multiple individual video streams directly from a Webex meeting. This capability enables more advanced video layouts and customized views, making it easier to create dynamic and engaging video conferencing experiences.</p> <h6>Key Benefits of Multistream</h6><p>These are the key benefits of the Webex Multistream technology:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Enhanced Video Layouts:</strong> With the ability to handle multiple streams, you can now create sophisticated video layouts, such as grids, active speaker views, and custom views tailored to specific use cases like in education, where teachers can create layouts that show the main lecture feed along with student video feeds, enabling more interactive and engaging lessons.</li> <li><strong>Optimized Bandwidth Usage</strong>: Control over individual streams helps in optimizing bandwidth usage by only subscribing to the streams you need. This is particularly useful in corporate settings, where large meetings and webinars often involve many participants, allowing you to focus bandwidth on key speakers and relevant departments, ensuring smooth video quality and effective communication.</li> <li><strong>Improved User Experience</strong>: Provide a more interactive and immersive meeting experience by using dynamic layouts as each participant&#39;s video feed is received as a separate stream. For example, in Media and Entertainment, you can offer viewers a richer experience with multiple perspectives during live event broadcasts, making the experience more engaging and dynamic.</li> </ul> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/bltafb3245399f04b5b/multi-stream-blog-2.png" alt="Image described in surrounding text."> <strong>Figure 1:</strong> Multistream in our Kitchen Sink app demonstrating Stage with thumbnails</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt0b120b97bfac8cab/multi-stream-blog-3.png" alt="Image described in surrounding text."> <strong>Figure 2:</strong> Multistream in our Kitchen Sink app demonstrating all equal panes (max 9).</p> <h6>Documentation</h6><p>This Multistream feature in the Browser SDK is available from version: <code>webex-js-sdk@3.3.1</code>. For detailed information, see:</p> <ul> <li><a data-type='internal' to='/docs/sdks/webex-meetings-sdk-web-multistream-quick-start'>Quick Start Guide:</a> Provides a step-by-step process to integrate Multistream capabilities into your Webex application.</li> <li><a data-type='internal' to='/docs/multistream-comprehensive-guide'>Comprehensive Guide:</a> Dives deeper into the Multistream functionality, offering advanced insights and best practices.</li> </ul> <div><Callout type="info">To try out the Multistream feature, check out our [Kitchen Sink](https://webex.github.io/webex-js-sdk/samples/browser-plugin-meetings/) app! </Callout></div> <h6>Other Helpful Links</h6><p>For additional information see:</p> <ul> <li><a href='https://github.com/webex/webex-js-sdk/wiki/Migrating-SDK-Version-1-or-Version-2-to-Version-3' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Migrating from SDK V1/V2 to V3</a></li> <li><a href='https://github.com/webex/webex-js-sdk/tree/next/docs/samples' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Source code of Kitchen Sink app</a></li> </ul> <br/> <h6>Vidcast Demo</h6><p>Check out our demo Vidcast:</p> <div style="padding-bottom:56.25%; position:relative; display:block; width: 100%"> <iframe src="https://app.vidcast.io/share/embed/c0ea5361-6bae-46ef-835f-0694a3046853" width="100%" height="100%" title="Multistream Using the Webex SDKs" frameborder="0" loading="lazy" allowfullscreen style="position:absolute; top:0; left: 0;border: solid; border-radius:12px"> </iframe> </div> <br/> <h6>Customer Testimonial</h6><p>Here, Jason Ruane from Cives shares his experience with the Multistream technology and how Cives leverages it in their solutions:</p> <p>&quot;At <a href='https://cives.ai/' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Cives</a>, integrating the Multistream feature into our flagship solution, Courts for Webex, has been a transformative step forward. This technology empowered us to develop a highly customized courtroom synoptic view, elevating the virtual courtroom experience.</p> <p>&quot;By utilizing multiple individual video streams, we crafted dynamic, real-time layouts tailored to the specific needs of judges, attorneys, and witnesses. This approach not only optimized bandwidth but also ensured that essential video feeds remained in focus, creating an immersive environment that meets the stringent requirements of modern judicial proceedings.</p> <p>&quot;Furthermore, <a href='https://x.com/civesofficial' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Cives</a> leveraged Multistream audio to route individual audio streams directly to court recording solutions, guaranteeing precise and dependable documentation for every session.&quot;</p> <p><img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt95765319b3a653b7/multi-stream-blog-4.png" alt="Image described in surrounding text."> <strong>Figure 3:</strong> Courts for Webex.</p> <h6>Conclusion</h6><p>The new Multistream feature in the Webex Web Meetings SDK opens up a world of possibilities for developers looking to enhance their video conferencing applications. We encourage you to explore the documentation, try out the examples, and start integrating Multistream into your Webex projects today.</p> <h6>Need Some Help? We Got You Covered!</h6><p>We are excited to provide you with support for these features. If you need help, the <a data-type='internal' to='/support'>Webex Developer Support Team</a> is standing by and happy to assist. You can also start or join a conversation on the <a href='https://cs.co/WebexDeveloperCommunity' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Webex for Developers Community Forum</a>.</p> ]]>
...
</description>

<item>
<title>
<![CDATA[ Webex for Developers Newsletter – September 2024 ]]>
...
</title>
<description>
<![CDATA[ <img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt21d3ca7f3f79e9ee/66a3c630b286e58a34216312/july-2024-webex-for-developers-newsletter---blog-1.png?width=900&height=317&fit=crop" alt="Webex for Developers Newsletter – September 2024" /> <p>Hello to our Webex Developers! We have a lot of new and updated content to share with you in this month’s newsletter, including our SDKs, APIs, and more. Keep reading to get all the exciting details!</p> <h6>👨🏻‍🔧 New! Service App Guest-to-Guest Meetings Guide</h6><p>In <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/service-apps-as-g2g-meeting-facilitator-guide'>newly published developer guide</a>, we explain how Webex Service Apps, in combination with a new subscription, can be used to automatically schedule meetings that do not include registered Webex users and are <em>only</em> between guests. This opens up a lot of flexible use cases for developers. Learn how it all comes together in the guide and start building today.</p> <h6>📲 Webex Mobile SDK: Seamless Meeting Movement and External Camera Support</h6><p>Our Mobile SDK engineers also made some great files available for capturing an audio dump in iOS and Android. These files provide developers with valuable information about the audio streams during calls or meetings, that can be analyzed to identify and resolve audio-related issues. Check out the guides on GitHub (<a href='https://github.com/webex/webex-ios-sdk/wiki/Troubleshooting-Audio-on-Mobile-SDKs' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>(iOS</a>/<a href='https://github.com/webex/webex-android-sdk/wiki/Troubleshooting-Audio-on-Mobile-SDK' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Android</a>) and watch the helpful <em>Vidcasts</em> (<a href='https://app.vidcast.io/share/933b9ee1-47ec-4fa7-bd1a-54d4ee885233' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>iOS</a>/<a href='https://app.vidcast.io/share/9cbcf215-f18f-4a25-8603-72478eb9e973' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Android</a>) to get started fast.</p> <h6>📣 New! Webex Web SDK Dedicated Changelog Site</h6><p>The Webex Web (JS) SDK now has a <a href='https://webex.github.io/webex-js-sdk/changelog/' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>dedicated changelog site on GitHub</a>, which gives developers a dynamic view of updates across each different version. Instead of hunting for specific releases and scrolling through every change made, developers can now select the Web SDK version number and package name, for quick access to the info they need. Head over to the new site and try it out.</p> <p>We also have a helpful <a href='https://app.vidcast.io/share/072f82d1-3735-4a13-8c74-1ece59723ff3' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>usage guide to watch on Vidcast</a> that will show you how to best utilize the new changelog site.</p> <h6>🖥️ Webex Developer Public Webinars</h6><p>As announced last month, don’t miss our next developer webinar: AI and Webex: Transforming Industries with Cutting-Edge Integrations, on Wednesday, September 25 at 1:00PM EDT. Discover how AI and Webex are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing. <a href='https://evangelism.webex.com/weblink/register/ra330ae2785174befb2b1fdf111e19431' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Register now</a> to join the live event!</p> <p>If you missed the live event, you could always watch the session recording later or check out other past events on our <a data-type='internal' to='/webinars'>webinars page</a>.</p> <h6>☎️ What’s New in the Webex Calling APIs</h6><p>In case you didn’t know, the Webex Calling platform has a <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/whats-new-calling'>&quot;What’s New&quot; page</a> on the Webex Developer portal, with new updates listed for each month. The Provisioning APIs particularly has several recent items that were listed over the last few months, so be sure to head over to that page and discover everything new.</p> <h6>🗓️ Webex Contact Center APIs - New Versions</h6><p>As noted in the <a data-type='internal' to='/webex-contact-center/docs/api/changelog/webex-contact-center'>Webex Contact Center API changelog</a> on <strong>September 8, 2024</strong>, the following APIs have a new version added: <a data-type='internal' to='/webex-contact-center/docs/api/v1/skill/list-skills'>List Skill API</a>, <a data-type='internal' to='/webex-contact-center/docs/api/v1/team/list-teams'>List Team API</a>, <a data-type='internal' to='/webex-contact-center/docs/api/v1/team/create-a-new-team'>Create a Team API</a>, <a data-type='internal' to='/webex-contact-center/docs/api/v1/entry-point/list-entry-points'>List Entry Points API</a>, and <a data-type='internal' to='/webex-contact-center/docs/api/v1/contact-service-queues/list-contact-service-queues'>List Contact Service Queue</a>.</p> <h6>📒 Webex API Changelog: Major Announcement</h6><p>September has several entries in the <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/changelog'>Webex API Changelog</a> and we always recommend checking this page frequently to stay up to date. There is one very important announcement that we want to call out again here:</p> <ul> <li><strong>August 23, 2024 - MAJOR:</strong> We are formally announcing that the Web Meetings SDK version v2 will reach its end-of-life (EOL) on September 30, 2025. The v1 SDKs are already EOL. As indicated on this change log in March and May we strongly encourage all users to migrate to SDK v3 (latest version: <code>webex@3.4.0)</code> at your earliest convenience to continue getting SDK support and feature upgrades while avoiding service disruptions on the Webex Suite Meetings Platform. Please refer to our <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/sdks/webex-meetings-sdk-migrating-2-to-3'>Migration Guide</a> for detailed instructions on making the transition.</li> </ul> ]]>

<title>
<![CDATA[ Elevating Airline Travel: Transforming Customer Experience with the Webex Web SDK! ]]>
...
</title>
<description>
<![CDATA[ <img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/bltc428382c13ef6c42/66e9b52fd962524d558c503d/bigairlinecasestudy-1.jpeg?width=900&height=317&fit=crop" alt="Elevating Airline Travel: Transforming Customer Experience with the Webex Web SDK!" /> <p>Waiting in long queues for customer service can be a traveller&#39;s worst nightmare. But what if you could get instant help with just a scan of your phone? Traditionally, airlines have relied on standard customer service methods, such as in-person help desks and phone support, to address passenger inquiries and issues. However, these methods often lead to long waiting times, with passengers sometimes being on hold on the phone for hours, causing frustration and dissatisfaction. A large airline, known for its long-standing presence in the aviation industry, has always been at the forefront of adopting advanced technologies to improve these interactions.</p> <p>To further enhance customer satisfaction and streamline the travel experience, this airline approached Cisco for innovative solutions. Cisco&#39;s expertise in advanced communication technologies provided the perfect partnership to revolutionize the way passengers receive assistance.</p> <p>Imagine Sarah, a flyer at the JFK Airport, rushing to board her flight. She suddenly realizes she has extra baggage and needs assistance. Instead of standing in long queues, Sarah opens her phone, scans a QR code present in the airport, and is instantly connected to a customer service agent via a Webex Meeting. Within moments, she receives the guidance she needs, making her journey smoother and more enjoyable. This blog explores how the airline leverages the <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/sdks/browser'>Webex Web SDK</a> to provide real-time, seamless customer service interactions at airports, enhancing the travel experience for their 140 million passengers annually.</p> <h6>The Challenge</h6><p>Coming back to our passenger, Sarah. On one occasion, she discovered her flight had been cancelled upon arriving at the airport. Traditional customer service methods, such as in-person help desks, were inefficient and slow, leaving her and many others frustrated and dissatisfied as they scrambled to rebook or reschedule their flights. The airline recognized that these issues negatively impacted their reputation and overall customer experience, highlighting the urgent need for a more sophisticated solution to address these challenges.</p> <h6>The Solution</h6><p>To address these challenges, a Cisco partner was able to implement a powerful solution for the large airline using the <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/sdks/browser'>Webex Web SDK</a>. It provides &quot;Real-Time Video Assistance,&quot; allowing passengers to initiate video calls (via a Webex meeting) with customer service representatives directly from their mobile devices or airport kiosks. This face-to-face communication leads to higher customer satisfaction and faster time to resolution, as agents can address issues more effectively and passengers feel more personally attended to.</p> <p>Consider our airline traveller, Sarah, who urgently needs to talk to a customer representative. Now, instead of waiting in the queue, Sarah does the following:</p> <ol> <li>She uses smartphone to scan a QR code present at multiple locations at the airport.</li> <li>This redirects her to a web app, and she gets connected to an agent immediately through a Webex meeting.</li> <li>Sarah then proceeds to ask her query to the agent and receives the prompt response.</li> <li>Once she is satisfied with her response, she simply ends the session.</li> </ol> <br/> <h6>Outcomes</h6><p>The solution generated the following outcomes:</p> <ul> <li>It improved the customer experience for the airline flyers, who can now access support from any location and do not need to wait in physical queues.</li> <li>As of today, the airline has over 192K monthly active users who are benefiting from the use of the <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/sdks/browser'>Web SDK</a>.</li> <li>The solution also powers 370K meetings on a quarterly basis.</li> </ul> <br/> <h6>Conclusion</h6><p>This integration of the <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/sdks/browser'>Webex Web SDK</a> is a testament to their dedication to innovation and customer satisfaction. By leveraging cutting-edge technology like the Webex SDK, the airline has set a new standard for customer service in the aviation industry. As they continue to evolve and enhance their offerings, passengers can look forward to an even more seamless and enjoyable travel experience.</p> <p>Interested in revolutionizing your customer service? Explore the <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/sdks/browser'>Webex Web SDK</a> today!</p> <h6>References</h6><p>For more information, see the following resources:</p> <ul> <li><a href='https://www.upstreamworks.com/customer-stories-united-airlines' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Upstream Works Case Study Video</a></li> <li><a data-type='internal' to='/docs/sdks/browser'>Webex Web SDK Developer Documentation</a></li> <li><a href='https://github.com/webex/webex-js-sdk' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Webex Web SDK Repo</a></li> <li><a href='https://webex.github.io/webex-js-sdk/' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Webex Web SDK Sample App</a></li> </ul> ]]>

<item>
<title>
<![CDATA[ Webex for Developers Newsletter – August 2024 ]]>
...
</title>
<description>
<![CDATA[ <img src="https://images.contentstack.io/v3/assets/bltd74e2c7e18c68b20/blt21d3ca7f3f79e9ee/66a3c630b286e58a34216312/july-2024-webex-for-developers-newsletter---blog-1.png?width=900&height=317&fit=crop" alt="Webex for Developers Newsletter – August 2024" /> <p>Greetings, Webex Developers! Great things are happening this month, as we have a slew of new content on both the Webex and Webex Contact Center platforms to learn more about. Keep reading to get all of the exciting details.</p> <h6>🛠️Build a Webex Connect Flow: Step by Step Guide</h6><p>In a <a data-type='internal' to='/blog/build-your-first-webex-connect-flow-a-step-by-step-guide'>new blog post</a> on the CPaaS side, Product Marketing Manager, Sam Watson shows us how we can work quicker and smarter by using the Flow Builder, which is a tool for building, configuring, deploying, and iterating workflows that automate communication processes across a customer journey in <a href='https://cpaas.webex.com/products/webex-connect' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Webex Connect.</a> He takes us step-by-step to create, test, and troubleshoot a Webex Connect flow, complete with screenshots and easy to follow instructions. It has never been easier to get started!</p> <h6>🧑‍💻Rapidly Adapt Your CX Workflows with Webex Contact Center Flow Designer</h6><p>In another <a data-type='internal' to='/blog/rapidly-adapt-your-cx-workflows-with-webex-contact-center-flow-designer'>blog post</a> published recently, Engineering Product Manager, Arunabh Bhattacharjee, covers all the recent updates on the Webex Contact Center Flow Designer platform. There are several new features to learn about, such as Flow Versioning, Percentage Allocation of Flow Traffic, Sub-flows and Dynamic Variable Support. Find out how these new features enable enterprise-grade CX change management for rapid and risk-free innovation.</p> <h6>⚙️Leveraging the Agent Desktop SDK to Build Custom Widgets in Webex Contact Center</h6><p>In the <a data-type='internal' to='/blog/leveraging-the-webex-contact-center-agent-desktop-sdk-in-your-custom-widgets'>next entry</a> in our Contact Center Custom Widgets blog series, Adam Weeks goes over the key features of the Desktop SDK. This is ideal for developers looking to build robust and interactive web apps within the Agent and Supervisor Desktop. Adam shows developers how to get started and provides a code tour of a handy sample app. You will learn how to manage agent states, handle interactions, and real-time data &amp; event handling.</p> <h6>📺New! Webex for Developers Content on YouTube</h6><p>You can find <em>Webex for Developers</em> videos on YouTube! We&#39;re thrilled to announce the new <a href='https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL2k86RlAekM_bIUrvVw4Haq_0xxTez9zU' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Webex for Developers YouTube playlist</a>, as part of Cisco DevNet channel. There is already a variety of content available to watch there, including developer how-to videos, product announcements, and recordings of our previous <a data-type='internal' to='/webinars'>developer webinars</a>. Go check out the playlist today!</p> <h6>🖥️Webex Developer Public Webinars</h6><p>Join the Webex Developer Evangelism team on Wednesday, September 25 at 1:00PM EDT, for our next public webinar: <strong>AI and Webex: Transforming Industries with Cutting-Edge Integrations</strong>. Discover how AI and Webex are revolutionizing healthcare, finance, retail, and manufacturing industries, and see some real-world integrations and innovative applications in action. <a href='https://evangelism.webex.com/weblink/register/r0d92a7f2591bb07c38dbda71ec830354' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Register for the live event today</a>!</p> <p>Otherwise, if you can’t make the live event, watch the session recording later or check out other past events over on our <a data-type='internal' to='/webinars'>webinars page</a>.</p> <h6>🧪Webex Developer βeta Program Activity</h6><p>The Webex Developer Beta Program lets you take a sneak peek and test out our upcoming features before they are released. We currently have two active beta features you can try out and provide feedback on now:</p> <ul> <li>Webex Space Widgets via CDN Beta</li> <li>Webex Meeting Widgets via NPM Beta</li> </ul> <p>Now is your chance to become a Webex “early-adopter” developer! To get started, head over to the <a href='https://gobeta.webex.com/key/dev-platform' rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank'>Developer Beta Program information page</a>.</p> <h6>🗓️Webex Contact Center API: Recent Updates</h6><p><strong>As noted in the <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/changelog'>API changelog</a> on August 14, 2024:</strong> We have updated the base URLs for the CJDS APIs across several environments:</p> <ul> <li>UL - <code>https://api.wxcc-us1.cisco.com</code></li> <li>EU1 - <code>https://api.wxcc-eu1.cisco.com</code></li> <li>EU2 - <code>https://api.wxcc-eu2.cisco.com</code></li> </ul> <p>If you are using any previous URLs, please re-enable the Webex Contact Center connector as outlined on the <a data-type='internal' to='/webex-contact-center/docs/journey-getting-started'>Getting Started page</a> to ensure you continue receiving contact center events for the journey widget.</p> <h6>📒Webex Platform API Changelog Highlights</h6><p>August has several entries in <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/changelog'>Webex API Changelog</a> and we always recommend checking this page frequently to stay up to date. Here are some latest items you can find there:</p> <ul> <li><strong>August 23, 2024 - NEW:</strong> As an administrator, you can reassign a list of call recordings or all call recordings of a particular user to a new user through the <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/v1/converged-recordings/reassign-recordings'>Reassign Recording</a> endpoint.</li> <li><strong>August 21, 2024 – NEW:</strong> Service numbers are now supported for Premises-based PSTN. These are local telephone numbers considered as high utilization or concurrent, making them ideal for assignment to high-volume services such as Auto Attendants, Hunt Groups, and Call Queues. The <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/v1/numbers/add-phone-numbers-to-a-location'>Add Numbers</a>, <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/v1/numbers/get-phone-numbers-for-an-organization-with-given-criterias'>Get Numbers</a>, and <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/v1/numbers/initiate-number-jobs'>Initiate Number Jobs</a> APIs are modified to support service numbers. Additionally, feature-specific available numbers APIs such as <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/v1/features-hunt-group/get-hunt-group-primary-available-phone-numbers'>Hunt Group</a>, <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/v1/location-call-settings/get-location-call-intercept-available-phone-numbers'>Location</a>, <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/v1/user-call-settings/get-person-primary-available-phone-numbers'>Person</a>, and <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/v1/workspace-call-settings/get-workspace-fax-message-available-phone-numbers'>Workspace</a> have been added to help identify numbers that can be associated with specific members or features. These feature-specific APIs are streamlined with fewer parameters, making them more easily to use as alternatives to the more general <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/v1/numbers/get-phone-numbers-for-an-organization-with-given-criterias'>Get Numbers</a> API.</li> <li><strong>August 21, 2024 – NEW:</strong> A new webhook resource allows you to receive notifications for status changes of admin batch jobs, reducing the need for manual status checks. For setup instructions and more details, see <a data-type='internal' to='/docs/api/v1/webhooks'>Webhooks Reference Page</a>.</li> </ul> ]]>
